title: Document Knowledge Assistant
objective: Answer questions from an authorized document collection with traceable evidence.
scenario: Answer questions from an authorized document collection with traceable evidence. Build incrementally, start with mock services, and record how critical behavior can be reproduced.

milestones.title: Document ingestion and chunking
acceptance_criteria: Document ingestion and chunking is demonstrated using a reproducible test case.
Relevant invalid, empty, unauthorized, or dependency-failure behavior is documented.

milestones.title: Embedding or hybrid retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Embedding or hybrid retrieval is demonstrated using a reproducible test case.
Relevant invalid, empty, unauthorized, or dependency-failure behavior is documented.

milestones.title: Grounded answers with source identifiers
acceptance_criteria: Grounded answers with source identifiers is demonstrated using a reproducible test case.
Relevant invalid, empty, unauthorized, or dependency-failure behavior is documented.

milestones.title: Insufficient-evidence responses
acceptance_criteria: Insufficient-evidence responses is demonstrated using a reproducible test case.
Relevant invalid, empty, unauthorized, or dependency-failure behavior is documented.

milestones.title: Tenant/user access filters before retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Tenant/user access filters before retrieval is demonstrated using a reproducible test case.
Relevant invalid, empty, unauthorized, or dependency-failure behavior is documented.

stretch_features: Add an automated regression test for every critical workflow.
Measure latency/cost or retrieval quality against a baseline.
Document versioned dependencies and provide a safe teardown/data-deletion procedure.
tests_and_validation: Run unit tests with mocked provider/tool responses first.
Cover normal, invalid, ambiguous, and dependency-failure inputs.
Record model/version details and reproducible evaluation results.
review_method: Human review of a reproducible implementation, test evidence, security/privacy controls, and the written limitations report.
status_note: Project brief and starter test cases are included. The solution is a protected design outline; the project itself has not been built or tested in this generation environment.
